name: Ostrów Mazowiecka County (Poland)
description: Three vertical stripes of green, yellow and green in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the county arms of Ostrów Mazowiecka: a quartered shield with a white eagle, a tree, stars and a dragon.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
